name: Ester Manas
production_model: Handmade in Brussels from deadstock fabric

prices.note: All 38 dresses regular price. Median €405. Butter Easy Slip Dress €190 to Signature Mesh & Textured Wool Midi Dress €1,960. Its US-market feed (country=US) shows $215.91–$2,227.29, a converted price above the ECB rate.

notes: meta.json: 'Ester Manas: ready-to-wear made for every body, literally. Ruched, sensual pieces handcrafted in Brussels from deadstock & EU fabrics.' Store currency EUR; ships_to_countries includes US, CA, GB, AU.

Shipping to the US: rest-of-world rate €30, free over €350; 'For deliveries outside the EU, duties and taxes remain the Customer's responsibility'; dispatch 2-4 business days, then about 4-10 business days.
Returns: 14 days from delivery; buyer pays the return label; exchanges ship free; outside-EU buyers also pay duties on the return.
Sizes from variants: XS/S, M/L, XL/XXL, 3XL, 4XL (some styles 34/44 and 44/50).
hq_country left empty: the shop address (Encausse, FR) and the Brussels workshop disagree.
